ops.title: Flaky under load: daemon trust-verifier self-probe times out (worker: timed out)
ops.description:
Two occurrences of the same signature, both proven independent of the diffs under test:

1. CI run 30178033882 (ubuntu-latest, commit 85d53fd, the v0.20.6 settlement-fix ship): TestProductSettlementClaimIsSingularStartingAndGenerationFenced failed with `daemon: trust verifier self-probe failed; the daemon executable must dispatch trust.RunVerifierChild: trust: run verifier child: worker: timed out / context deadline exceeded`, alongside deferred-untrack WARNs. Passed on rerun.

2. Local (2026-07-26, helper-plist fix wave, machine carrying the agent fleet at ~950-1000 uid procs): daemon package fails identically at the clean base commit (stash → run → pop verified) while the diff's own package (service) is green in isolation.

The trust-verifier self-probe spawns a real child through the worker machinery under a fixed deadline; under host load the spawn+handshake starves. Same class as fusekit's holder readiness flake (fusekit backlog 6f39134, filed the same day). Fix is a deliberate look at the probe deadline/backoff under load — not a blind timeout bump.

ops.text: daemon-package tests pass -race -count=1 on a machine carrying ~1000 uid processes and on shared CI runners without self-probe timeouts
